classes.summary: A controller and self-sustaining damage dealer who changes roles by transforming between human and beast forms.
strengths: Human form combines control, blight, and recovery.
Beast form provides fast burst damage with useful reach.
limitations: Transforming causes party stress.
His complete kit depends heavily on party position 2.

positionGuidance.reason: This is the only position that preserves the complete human and beast kits.
Human-form control remains useful, but beast-form options are restricted.

mechanics.description: Transform is a free action that exchanges human control skills for beast attacks and causes stress.

useCases: Switch to beast form when immediate damage is worth the stress cost.
synergies: Stress healing makes repeated transformation safer.
cautions: Transformation stresses allies and beast turns continue to stress the Abomination.

useCases: Stun a reachable enemy while remaining in human form.
synergies: Stunned targets enable Finish Him.
cautions: Its base stun chance needs support against resistant enemies.

useCases: Apply blight and blight-resistance pressure to the enemy middle ranks.
synergies: Helps other blight users land subsequent effects.
cautions: Avoid relying on it against highly blight-resistant enemies.

useCases: Recover personal health and stress during a safe combat window.
synergies: Control from allies creates time for recovery.
cautions: It does not advance damage or protect teammates that turn.

useCases: Cleave the enemy front while building damage for repeated uses.
synergies: Enemy pulls can keep priority targets in its reach.
cautions: Requires beast form and gives up human control tools.

useCases: Burst down a high-priority or boss target in beast form.
synergies: Accuracy and stress support improve sustained beast offense.
cautions: Transform only when the extra damage justifies party stress.

useCases: Move forward while pushing and slowing an enemy.
synergies: Useful for recovering after the Abomination is displaced backward.
cautions: Its movement can disturb allies in a fixed formation.

reasons: Stress healing offsets the cost of transformation.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Abomination strategy

classes.summary: An economic and defensive support hero who increases expedition loot at the cost of direct combat power.
strengths: Enables unique antiques and larger gold stacks.
Can stack party dodge and redirect attacks toward an ally.
limitations: Has low direct damage.
Cannot replace a dedicated healer or damage dealer.

positionGuidance.reason: Back positions keep her safer while preserving defensive support.
Her broad access tolerates shuffles, but front placement exposes a fragile hero.

mechanics.description: Her presence enables antique loot and increases the maximum size of gold stacks.

useCases: Contribute direct damage when no support action is urgent.
cautions: Its damage remains modest compared with a dedicated attacker.

useCases: Apply blight and reduce blight resistance on any reachable enemy.
synergies: Sets up stronger blight from Plague Doctor or Abomination.
cautions: The Antiquarian's own blight is relatively weak.

useCases: Retreat toward safety and increase personal dodge after disruption.
synergies: Restores a backline formation while defensive buffs accumulate.
cautions: Consumes an action without directly helping an endangered ally.

useCases: Reduce a dangerous enemy's accuracy and remove stealth.
synergies: Stacks conceptually with party dodge support.
cautions: A single-target debuff may be too slow against several threats.

useCases: Provide a small heal and improve resistance to bleed and blight.
synergies: Works best in parties with additional self-healing.
cautions: Do not treat it as a dependable primary heal.

useCases: Stack party-wide dodge during fights where avoidance is reliable.
synergies: Combines with accuracy debuffs and other dodge buffs.
cautions: Dodge never guarantees safety and repeated setup costs tempo.

useCases: Redirect attacks from the Antiquarian to a durable or riposting ally.
synergies: Riposte users gain more counterattack opportunities.
cautions: Do not redirect attacks to an ally that cannot sustain focused damage.

reasons: Protect Me can direct attacks into an active riposte.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Antiquarian strategy

classes.summary: A durable backline marksman who converts marks into accurate ranged damage and supplies secondary healing and debuffs.
strengths: Combines high accuracy with strong marked-target scaling.
Has high health for a backliner and useful support options.
limitations: Most of her kit is unavailable in the front.
Low speed favors marks established by a faster ally.

positionGuidance.reason: Her primary attacks and support skills are designed for the back ranks.
A faster forward-moving ally can open a back position before she acts.

mechanics.description: Her primary shot gains substantial value against marked enemies.

useCases: Deal primary ranged damage, especially against a marked target.
synergies: Use a faster ally to establish the mark first.
cautions: Frontline displacement can disable the shot.

useCases: Reduce backline accuracy and critical chance in prolonged fights.
synergies: Strengthens dodge-oriented defensive plans.
cautions: Repeated debuffing delays focused kills.

useCases: Mark and reduce dodge when no ally can provide better setup.
synergies: Supports other marked-target attackers.
cautions: Self-marking often costs the attack that should exploit the mark.

useCases: Attack and disrupt the enemy frontline or recover limited offense after displacement.
cautions: Spread damage is usually weaker than eliminating one threat.

useCases: Attack while displaced and gain speed for a following round.
synergies: Can help restore favorable turn order.
cautions: Random targeting cannot reliably remove a priority enemy.

useCases: Provide secondary healing and amplify later heals on an ally.
synergies: Improves follow-up healing from Vestal or Occultist.
cautions: Cannot heal the Arbalest herself.

useCases: Clear marks and stuns from allies or remove enemy stealth.
synergies: Useful against encounters built around marks or stealth.
cautions: Its utility is encounter-dependent and deals no focused damage.

reasons: Target Whistle supplies both a mark and protection reduction.

classes.summary: A flexible disruption and execution specialist who exploits marked or stunned enemies.
strengths: Can reach and disrupt dangerous backliners.
Deals exceptional conditional damage against marked or stunned targets.
limitations: Has no recovery skills.
Different plans compete for skills, trinkets, and setup actions.

positionGuidance.reason: Middle positions preserve broad access to damage and disruption.
Front placement supports some attacks but narrows his reach.

mechanics.description: Different attacks gain large bonuses against marked or stunned enemies.

useCases: Execute a marked frontline target with strong conditional damage.
synergies: A faster mark user preserves the Bounty Hunter's attack action.
cautions: Its target reach is narrower than Finish Him.

useCases: Mark and reduce protection when setting up multiple follow-up attacks.
synergies: Supports Arbalest, Musketeer, and Houndmaster.
cautions: Often less efficient than letting another hero mark.

useCases: Pull and mark a dangerous backliner in one action.
synergies: Moves targets into frontline attack reach.
cautions: Move-resistant enemies may keep their position.

useCases: Stun and knock back a frontline enemy during control or recovery turns.
synergies: Can expose a different enemy to frontline attacks.
cautions: Frontline enemies often have meaningful stun and move resistance.

useCases: Stun and shuffle a dangerous enemy in the backmost position.
synergies: Sets up Finish Him on the next action.
cautions: Shuffle results are not deterministic.

useCases: Deal broad-reach damage with a bonus against stunned targets.
synergies: Fast stunners can establish its conditional bonus.
cautions: The bonus is unavailable after stun expires.

useCases: Apply bleed to a middle-rank target when direct burst is unsuitable.
synergies: Fits bleed-focused parties and protected targets.
cautions: Bleed resistance can make it inefficient.

reasons: The Houndmaster can establish marks before the Bounty Hunter attacks.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bounty Hunter strategy

classes.summary: A durable generalist combining frontline damage with stuns, recovery, and a forward movement attack.
strengths: High health and broad recovery utility make him dependable.
Can work in stationary frontlines or coordinated movement parties.
limitations: Very low speed often lets enemies act first.
Direct attacks have limited reach without movement setup.

positionGuidance.reason: Front positions support his standard attacks and durable frontline role.
Starting back is useful when intentionally cycling his forward attack.

mechanics.description: He can restore both health and stress, though neither option replaces a specialist under pressure.

useCases: Deal reliable frontline damage with an Unholy bonus.
synergies: Particularly effective where Unholy enemies are common.
cautions: Cannot reach enemy backliners.

useCases: Damage both frontline enemies when neither can be finished individually.
cautions: Focused damage is usually better when one threat can be killed.

useCases: Control a frontline enemy or create a recovery window.
synergies: Enables stunned-target bonuses.
cautions: Its reach is limited to the enemy front.

useCases: Mark and harden the Crusader when drawing attacks is desirable.
synergies: Healing support sustains the resulting focus fire.
cautions: Marking does not guarantee every enemy will target him.

useCases: Stabilize an ally during a safe or emergency recovery turn.
synergies: Supplements another healer rather than replacing one under heavy pressure.
cautions: The heal is modest compared with specialist healing.

useCases: Attack enemy back ranks while moving the Crusader forward.
synergies: Dance partners can repeatedly reopen its launch position.
cautions: Requires starting behind the frontline and changes allied positions.

useCases: Restore stress and torchlight while providing a small heal.
synergies: Use during controlled recovery windows.
cautions: It is too slow to answer severe immediate health pressure alone.

reasons: Their movement patterns can cycle positions without disabling either hero.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Crusader strategy

classes.summary: A fast, evasive damage dealer using movement, blight interaction, and armor piercing to reach priority targets.
strengths: High speed and reach help remove enemies before they act.
Movement and armor piercing answer protected formations.
limitations: Low health makes failed dodge rolls dangerous.
Movement builds require position-tolerant teammates.

positionGuidance.reason: Back positions enable her powerful forward opener and ranged options.
Several attacks remain available, but her movement opener needs resetting.

mechanics.description: Some attacks gain additional damage against blighted targets.

useCases: Pierce protection on a frontline target without requiring blight setup.
cautions: Its reach is limited compared with her thrown attacks.

useCases: Open with high damage against a priority middle or back target while moving forward.
synergies: A dance partner can move forward afterward and reset her launch position.
cautions: The movement can disrupt fixed-position allies.

useCases: Damage two middle enemies and reduce their bleed resistance.
synergies: Prepares targets for allied bleed attacks.
cautions: Spread damage may delay removing a single dangerous enemy.

useCases: Move backward, gain stealth, and prepare a stronger following attack.
synergies: Sets up Lunge while reducing immediate exposure.
cautions: Spending a turn on setup can lose tempo.

useCases: Finish a reachable target with accurate ranged damage.
synergies: Benefits from mark or blight already applied to its target.
cautions: Does not reach the enemy frontmost position.

useCases: Apply blight and reduce blight resistance at range.
synergies: Enables her own and allied blight payoffs.
cautions: Resistant enemies may make direct damage preferable.

useCases: Clear personal bleed and blight while gaining defensive speed and dodge.
synergies: Useful before expected focused attacks.
cautions: Limited uses and no immediate enemy pressure make timing important.

reasons: Reliable blight enables her conditional damage.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Grave Robber strategy

classes.summary: A frontline damage dealer with rare back-rank reach, bleed attacks, limited control, and self-recovery.
strengths: Can strike every enemy position from the front.
High damage and a two-target frontline stun provide strong pressure.
limitations: Her defining backline attack requires party position 1.
Several powerful skills impose temporary penalties.

positionGuidance.reason: The front enables her complete reach, including enemy position 4.
Most general attacks remain usable after the enemy backline is handled.

mechanics.description: Several high-impact attacks trade immediate power for temporary personal penalties.

useCases: Deal straightforward damage to a frontline enemy.
cautions: It provides no control or special reach.

useCases: Eliminate a dangerous enemy in the backmost position from party position 1.
synergies: Accuracy support improves this high-priority opening attack.
cautions: It becomes unavailable if the Hellion leaves the frontmost position.

useCases: Stun both frontline enemies during control or recovery turns.
synergies: Can deny two actions when both stuns land.
cautions: It debuffs the Hellion and frontline enemies often resist stun.

useCases: Reach a middle target and apply bleed.
synergies: Completes the Hellion's ability to attack every enemy position.
cautions: Bleed resistance reduces its value.

useCases: Move forward after displacement while damaging several enemies.
synergies: Provides shuffle recovery in movement-tolerant parties.
cautions: It self-debuffs and spreads damage instead of focusing a kill.

useCases: Clear bleed and blight, heal slightly, and improve offense.
synergies: Useful during a controlled recovery window.
cautions: Limited uses prevent it from serving as routine sustain.

useCases: Apply very high damage and bleed to the frontmost enemy.
synergies: Best when a durable high-value target is already in front.
cautions: Narrow reach and self-debuffs make it situational.

reasons: Consistent healing supports an aggressive frontline build.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Hellion strategy

classes.summary: A mobile damage dealer with broad reach whose riposte converts enemy attacks into additional offense.
strengths: Can attack nearly every enemy position from several party positions.
Riposte can generate multiple extra attacks.
limitations: Provides almost no recovery or control.
Riposte value depends on enemy targeting and ends when stunned.

positionGuidance.reason: Middle positions preserve ranged reach and his forward riposte attack.
He can recover through movement, but some attacks are temporarily unavailable.

mechanics.description: An active riposte counterattacks enemies that target him.

useCases: Deal direct melee damage to a reachable enemy.
cautions: It offers less utility than his bleed alternative.

useCases: Reach and finish dangerous backline enemies.
synergies: A mark provides a modest damage bonus.
cautions: Cannot target the enemy frontmost position.

useCases: Deliver high frontline damage while moving backward from party position 1.
synergies: Can reset a forward dance cycle.
cautions: Strict launch and target positions make it situational.

useCases: Pressure several frontline enemies or accumulate critical vulnerability.
synergies: More useful in long wave-based fights.
cautions: Focused attacks usually remove threats faster.

useCases: Prepare accuracy, critical chance, and dodge before a valuable attack sequence.
synergies: Long boss fights provide time to recover the setup action.
cautions: Most short fights reward immediate damage instead.

useCases: Move forward, attack with broad reach, and establish riposte.
synergies: Guards or redirected targeting can create more riposte triggers.
cautions: Stuns disable riposte and movement may disrupt allies.

useCases: Apply accurate melee damage, bleed, and speed reduction.
synergies: Repeated use can improve bleed reliability on the target.
cautions: Bleed-resistant enemies may favor Wicked Slice.

reasons: Protect Me directs attacks toward riposte while improving defenses.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Highwayman strategy

classes.summary: A flexible support attacker offering mark synergy, protection reduction, stress healing, guard, stun, and self-healing.
strengths: Can reach every enemy position and adapt to many party needs.
Combines efficient mark setup with defensive utility.
limitations: Base damage is modest without bonuses.
Stress healing and guard builds need upgrades or repeated actions.

positionGuidance.reason: These positions support flexible offense, recovery, mark, and guard combinations.
Front placement supports his stun but restricts backline utility.

mechanics.description: Guard Dog protects an ally while temporarily increasing the Houndmaster's dodge.

useCases: Attack any enemy position and exploit marks or Beast type.
synergies: Target Whistle establishes both mark and protection reduction.
cautions: Base damage and accuracy benefit from support.

useCases: Apply party-wide bleed or finish multiple weakened enemies.
synergies: Especially effective against linked multi-part targets.
cautions: Distributed damage is inefficient against ordinary priority targets.

useCases: Mark a target and reduce protection for concentrated attacks.
synergies: Supports Arbalest, Musketeer, and Bounty Hunter.
cautions: The setup is wasted if the party cannot exploit it promptly.

useCases: Reduce party stress during a controlled recovery phase.
synergies: Upgrades greatly improve its expected value.
cautions: Low-level reliability is poor and it does not stop immediate threats.

useCases: Guard an endangered ally while increasing personal dodge.
synergies: Additional dodge buffs can make repeated guarding more reliable.
cautions: The short guard duration may require repeated actions.

useCases: Restore the Houndmaster's own health during recovery.
synergies: Guarding plus self-healing reduces demand on the party healer.
cautions: It cannot heal teammates.

useCases: Reliably stun a reachable enemy from the frontline.
synergies: Creates time for party recovery or stunned-target attacks.
cautions: Requires a forward party position and cannot reach position 4.

reasons: His mark and protection reduction amplify her marked-target shot.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Houndmaster strategy

classes.summary: A fast stress healer and combat buffer who can add bleed damage or build toward a risky movement-based burst attack.
strengths: Provides reliable stress recovery and a strong party buff.
High speed lets him establish support before many enemies act.
limitations: Low health punishes exposed frontline turns.
Finale play requires movement planning and sacrifices support actions.

positionGuidance.reason: Back positions safely enable stress healing and party buffs.
Position 2 supports bleed and movement sequences but exposes him.

mechanics.description: Movement skills build Finale damage; Finale then moves him back and imposes lasting penalties.

useCases: Move forward while attacking and prepare a movement sequence.
synergies: Builds Finale while changing formation.
cautions: Movement can displace allies and expose the Jester.

useCases: Apply bleed to both middle enemies.
synergies: Works when two reachable targets will survive long enough for bleed to tick.
cautions: Spread damage is poor when one target can be killed immediately.

useCases: Cash in Finale setup for a high-damage attack and retreat.
synergies: Prior movement skills increase its damage.
cautions: Its lasting self-debuffs make early or repeated use costly.

useCases: Move to the front, reduce enemy accuracy, and build Finale.
synergies: Sets up Heroic End on a later action.
cautions: It exposes a fragile hero and spends a turn without focused damage.

useCases: Apply concentrated bleed and stress vulnerability to a middle target.
synergies: Supports parties that exploit stress damage or bleed.
cautions: Target reach is limited and bleed can be resisted.

useCases: Buff party accuracy, critical chance, and speed before attacks.
synergies: Particularly valuable for slow or inaccurate damage dealers.
cautions: Repeated buffing can delay killing priority enemies.

useCases: Provide reliable targeted stress healing and reduce future stress received.
synergies: Stuns create safe time to recover stress.
cautions: It does not address immediate health danger.

reasons: Stress healing controls the cost of transformation.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Jester strategy

classes.summary: A self-sufficient frontline specialist with exceptional raw damage and durability but limited reach and accuracy.
strengths: Very high health and melee damage dominate accessible targets.
Strong self-recovery reduces dependence on party support.
limitations: Low base accuracy needs support or equipment.
Poor backline reach and movement tolerance make shuffles dangerous.

positionGuidance.reason: His attacks and self-sustain are built around the front two positions.
A displaced Leper loses most offensive options.

mechanics.description: Exceptional raw damage is balanced by attacks that primarily reach the enemy frontline.

useCases: Deal heavy focused damage to a frontline target.
synergies: Accuracy buffs and enemy pulls address its main restrictions.
cautions: Low accuracy and limited reach require planning.

useCases: Damage both frontline enemies when neither can be finished efficiently.
cautions: Focused damage is generally better for removing an action.

useCases: Improve accuracy and critical chance before sustained attacks.
synergies: Useful in long fights where the buff affects several actions.
cautions: A setup turn may be too slow in short encounters.

useCases: Trade defenses for major offensive bonuses in a planned damage race.
synergies: Guard and healing reduce the risk of its defensive penalties.
cautions: The defensive loss is dangerous under focused enemy pressure.

useCases: Mark and harden the Leper when absorbing attacks benefits the party.
synergies: Healing support sustains the resulting focus fire.
cautions: Self-mark does not guarantee enemy targeting.

useCases: Recover substantial personal health and stress during safe turns.
synergies: Makes low-healing parties more sustainable.
cautions: Limited uses and self-only recovery cannot rescue allies.

useCases: Reduce an enemy's damage while marking the Leper and maintaining broad reach.
synergies: Useful against a durable enemy that cannot be killed immediately.
cautions: Debuff resistance can make the action unreliable.

reasons: Accuracy buffs address the Leper's main reliability problem.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Leper strategy

classes.summary: A defensive specialist who protects allies, buffs the party, controls the frontline, and punishes attacks with riposte.
strengths: Guard and protection buffs protect vulnerable allies.
Party buffs and riposte remain valuable in long fights.
limitations: Personal damage is modest without riposte triggers.
Defensive actions do not immediately remove dangerous enemies.

positionGuidance.reason: He remains broadly functional across front and middle positions.
Some support remains, but control and riposte options narrow.

mechanics.description: Guard redirects attacks from a selected ally to the Man-at-Arms.
Retribution marks him and establishes a counterattack.

useCases: Contribute direct damage when no defensive action is urgent.
cautions: Damage is modest compared with dedicated attackers.

useCases: Move forward while stunning and pushing a frontline enemy.
synergies: Recovers formation after the Man-at-Arms is displaced backward.
cautions: Movement can disturb position-dependent allies.

useCases: Reduce enemy speed and dodge before allied attacks.
synergies: Improves party turn order and accuracy against evasive groups.
cautions: Debuff resistance and setup tempo limit reliability.

useCases: Guard a vulnerable ally while increasing protection.
synergies: Strong healing keeps the guarder safe under concentrated damage.
cautions: Area attacks can still affect both heroes.

useCases: Mark the Man-at-Arms and establish riposte.
synergies: Guarding or predictable enemy targeting creates counterattacks.
cautions: Stun and attacks that avoid him reduce riposte value.

useCases: Improve party accuracy and damage while enabling guard-related bonuses.
synergies: Supports inaccurate heroes and coordinated guard plans.
cautions: The buff action competes with immediate control or protection.

useCases: Apply a battle-long party dodge and stress-resistance buff.
synergies: Strong in long fights and dodge-oriented parties.
cautions: Its limited use and setup cost are inefficient in short encounters.

reasons: His guard compensates for her low durability.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Man-at-Arms strategy

classes.summary: A free-DLC counterpart to the Arbalest with nearly identical marked-target damage, support, and positional needs.
strengths: Combines high accuracy with strong marked-target scaling.
Provides secondary healing and enemy suppression.
limitations: Most abilities require the back two positions.
Her mechanics largely duplicate the Arbalest.

positionGuidance.reason: Her primary shots and support actions are designed for the backline.
A faster dancer may move forward and open a back position.

mechanics.description: She is mechanically almost identical to the Arbalest but has distinct names, visuals, and trinkets.

useCases: Deal primary ranged damage, especially against a marked target.
synergies: Use a faster ally to establish the mark first.
cautions: Frontline displacement can disable the shot.

useCases: Reduce backline accuracy and critical chance in prolonged fights.
synergies: Strengthens dodge-oriented defensive plans.
cautions: Repeated debuffing delays focused kills.

useCases: Mark and reduce dodge when no ally can provide better setup.
synergies: Supports other marked-target attackers.
cautions: Self-marking often costs the attack that should exploit the mark.

useCases: Attack and disrupt the enemy frontline or recover limited offense after displacement.
cautions: Spread damage is usually weaker than eliminating one threat.

useCases: Attack while displaced and gain speed for a following round.
synergies: Can help restore favorable turn order.
cautions: Random targeting cannot reliably remove a priority enemy.

useCases: Provide secondary healing and amplify later heals on an ally.
synergies: Improves follow-up healing from Vestal or Occultist.
cautions: Cannot heal the Musketeer herself.

useCases: Clear marks and stuns from allies or remove enemy stealth.
synergies: Useful against encounters built around marks or stealth.
cautions: Its utility is encounter-dependent and deals no focused damage.

reasons: Target Whistle supplies mark setup and protection reduction.

classes.summary: A flexible support hero with variable healing, strong marks and debuffs, enemy movement, and a frontline stun.
strengths: Combines healing with mark setup, protection reduction, pulls, and stuns.
Supports both backline and frontline control builds.
limitations: His heal is random and may add bleed.
The frontline stun costs torchlight and exposes a fragile hero.

positionGuidance.reason: Back placement safely supports healing, marking, pulling, and debuffs.
Front placement enables his strong stun but changes his support package.

mechanics.description: Wyrd Reconstruction can heal from zero to a high value and may inflict bleed.

useCases: Apply direct damage, bleed, and an offensive debuff to a frontline target.
synergies: Provides offense in a frontline Occultist build.
cautions: Bleed resistance and limited reach reduce reliability.

useCases: Damage both enemy backliners with a bonus against Eldritch targets.
synergies: Pairs with other backline pressure.
cautions: Spread damage may be slower than killing one priority enemy.

useCases: Reduce the damage and protection of a durable enemy.
synergies: Helps physical attackers damage protected targets.
cautions: Debuff resistance can negate the setup action.

useCases: Attempt a potentially large single-target heal.
synergies: Healing-received buffs improve its successful outcomes.
cautions: It can heal for zero and may inflict bleed, so keep a backup recovery plan.

useCases: Mark a target while reducing dodge for concentrated attacks.
synergies: Enables Arbalest, Musketeer, Houndmaster, and Bounty Hunter.
cautions: The mark is wasted if allies cannot exploit it promptly.

useCases: Deliver a strong frontline stun from a forward position.
synergies: Creates recovery time or enables stunned-target damage.
cautions: It reduces torchlight and requires exposing the Occultist near the front.

useCases: Pull a backliner forward and clear corpses.
synergies: Moves priority targets into limited-range frontline attacks.
cautions: Move resistance can prevent repositioning.

reasons: His mark enables her damage while her bandage improves later healing.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Occultist strategy

classes.summary: A fast backline controller specializing in stuns, blight, corpse disruption, and bleed or blight removal.
strengths: Can stun both enemy backliners and blight through protection.
Battlefield Medicine removes dangerous damage-over-time effects.
limitations: Low direct damage struggles against blight resistance.
Being pulled forward disables much of her kit.

positionGuidance.reason: The backline preserves multi-target control, blight, and cleansing.
Some options remain, but her defining tools are restricted.

mechanics.description: Battlefield Medicine removes bleed and blight from an ally and the Plague Doctor.

useCases: Apply concentrated blight and accuracy reduction to a frontline target.
synergies: Repeated blight ignores protection and compounds over time.
cautions: High blight resistance makes direct alternatives preferable.

useCases: Apply blight to both enemy backliners.
synergies: Supports Grave Robber's blighted-target damage.
cautions: Damage over time may be too slow when an immediate kill is possible.

useCases: Attempt to stun both enemy backliners before they act.
synergies: Denies stress and control actions while allies attack.
cautions: Limited uses and rising stun resistance prevent indefinite control.

useCases: Use direct melee bleed against blight-resistant enemies.
synergies: Offers an alternate damage type in hostile regions.
cautions: Requires a more forward position than her main backline kit.

useCases: Clear bleed and blight from an ally and the Plague Doctor while healing slightly.
synergies: Prevents large pending damage-over-time ticks.
cautions: The direct heal is too small to replace a primary healer.

useCases: Apply a limited-use damage and speed buff for a long or critical fight.
synergies: Amplifies a dedicated damage dealer over multiple turns.
cautions: Setup is inefficient if the fight will end quickly.

useCases: Stun and shuffle one enemy while clearing a corpse.
synergies: Corpse clearing opens back targets to limited-range allies.
cautions: Shuffle results are not predictable.

reasons: Blight enables the Grave Robber's conditional damage.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Plague Doctor strategy

classes.summary: A dependable healer whose backline kit combines single-target and party recovery with stun and light support.
strengths: Provides consistent single-target and party-wide healing.
Can contribute stuns and light when healing is unnecessary.
limitations: A conventional healing loadout requires the back two positions.
Frequent healing becomes passive if the party lacks damage and control.

positionGuidance.reason: Back placement enables both primary heals and ranged support.
A melee build is possible but gives up conventional healing access.

mechanics.description: Divine Comfort can remove multiple heroes from Death's Door with one action.

useCases: Deal frontline melee damage when using a forward Vestal build.
cautions: Forward placement sacrifices access to her standard single-target heal.

useCases: Damage an enemy while restoring some of the Vestal's own health.
synergies: Lets her contribute offense without abandoning self-sustain.
cautions: The self-heal does not help an endangered ally.

useCases: Stun a reachable enemy and increase torchlight.
synergies: Creates time for healing or focused attacks.
cautions: Stun resistance can make healing or damage the safer action.

useCases: Provide dependable focused healing to one endangered ally.
synergies: Healing-received buffs increase its value.
cautions: It requires a backline Vestal and cannot restore the whole party.

useCases: Heal the entire party or remove several heroes from Death's Door.
synergies: Efficient when damage is distributed across the party.
cautions: Individual healing is modest against focused damage.

useCases: Reduce enemy dodge, remove stealth, and increase torchlight.
synergies: Improves allied accuracy against an evasive priority target.
cautions: It competes with the Vestal's crucial healing actions.

useCases: Attack and debuff a frontline enemy while empowering the Vestal's offense.
synergies: Supports a deliberate frontline Vestal build.
cautions: Its position requirements conflict with conventional backline healing.

reasons: Stable healing lets the Hellion focus on frontline pressure.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Vestal strategy

classes.summary: A frontline bleed and recovery specialist whose strongest emergency abilities require low health.
strengths: Applies powerful bleed while supporting health and stress recovery.
Low-health abilities provide major emergency value.
limitations: Bleed offense loses value against resistant enemies.
Low-health bonuses do not make Death's Door safe.

positionGuidance.reason: His bleed attacks require the front while support remains broadly accessible.
Back placement removes his main offensive contribution.

mechanics.description: Several powerful limited-use skills become available only below a health threshold.
At maximum stress he always becomes Rapturous instead of rolling a normal affliction or virtue.

useCases: Apply heavy bleed to a frontline target.
synergies: Bleed resistance reduction improves reliability.
cautions: Performs poorly against bleed-resistant enemies.

useCases: Apply bleed pressure to both enemy backliners.
synergies: Pairs with other backline pressure to deny stress dealers.
cautions: Damage over time may act too slowly when an immediate kill is available.

useCases: Convert low health into a limited-use self-heal and powerful bleed attack.
synergies: Controlled healing helps enter and leave its health threshold safely.
cautions: Do not remain at dangerous health merely to enable it.

useCases: Apply healing over time to an ally before damage becomes critical.
synergies: Another healer can cover immediate spikes while restoration ticks.
cautions: It causes bleed on the Flagellant and is not instant rescue healing.

useCases: Use a limited low-health action to heal both an ally and the Flagellant.
synergies: Can rescue two endangered heroes in one turn.
cautions: Health threshold and use limits prevent routine reliance.

useCases: Transfer stress from an ally to the Flagellant.
synergies: His camping and other recovery can manage the transferred stress.
cautions: It moves rather than deletes stress and can push him toward Rapturous.

useCases: Take an ally's mark and damage-over-time effects while gaining defenses.
synergies: Useful when the Flagellant can cleanse or exploit the transferred pressure.
cautions: Transferred bleed or blight can become lethal without a recovery plan.

reasons: Together they cover both major damage-over-time types and cleanse them from allies.

classes.summary: A fast, mobile damage dealer specializing in armor piercing, guard bypass, blight, and formation disruption.
strengths: Armor piercing and guard bypass answer protected targets.
Broad reach and movement work through changing formations.
limitations: Low maximum health makes focused damage dangerous.
Movement can disable position-dependent allies.

positionGuidance.reason: Front positions support armor-piercing attacks and mobile damage.
She can move forward while attacking if displaced allies remain functional.

mechanics.description: Aegis blocks the next direct damaging attack but not stress or damage over time.
Camping can trigger a sequence of Shieldbreaker nightmare encounters.

useCases: Use a mobile armor-piercing attack against a protected target.
synergies: Forward movement supports a dance rotation.
cautions: Movement can disrupt position-dependent allies.

useCases: Bypass guard, break the guard relationship, and expose the protector.
synergies: Allows the party to focus the originally protected target.
cautions: Its special value disappears when no guard is active.

useCases: Apply strong blight to a frontline target while moving backward.
synergies: Can reset the Shieldbreaker after forward movement.
cautions: Strict positioning and blight resistance make it situational.

useCases: Damage multiple enemies with armor piercing from a forward position.
synergies: Useful when several protected enemies are already weakened.
cautions: Spread damage usually removes actions more slowly than focused attacks.

useCases: Move backward while removing stealth and lowering speed and dodge.
synergies: Prepares an exposed target for allied attacks.
cautions: Movement must fit the party's formation plan.

useCases: Damage and blight a target, gaining bonus damage when it is marked.
synergies: A faster ally can establish the mark before the Shieldbreaker attacks.
cautions: It does not pierce protection and loses part of its value without a mark.

useCases: Gain Aegis blocks and move forward before expected direct attacks.
synergies: Protects her low health while restoring front position.
cautions: Aegis does not block stress or existing bleed and blight.

reasons: Both heroes tolerate movement and alternate forward or backward attacks.
